concept: Amazon MQ: migrate a JMS/AMQP app without rewriting
tests: Choosing a managed broker for a legacy application that uses open messaging protocols.
expected: Amazon MQ (managed ActiveMQ/RabbitMQ) — supports JMS, AMQP, MQTT, STOMP. Triggers: "legacy on-premises", "JMS/AMQP", "minimal code changes".
why_not: SQS and SNS are proprietary AWS APIs and require rewriting the messaging layer; EventBridge is an event routing bus, not a drop-in broker.
